author: urbansniper10
body:
Hello Avicans!

I have a suggestion for avicus,  so I loved avicus before the "Omega Update" and I loved prestiges. I was wondering if we could bring them back. This is how I think it would work
You need to get as much credits as you needed to do to /prestige. Once you hit the amount of xp/credits for prestige thats when the badges comes in. I have no idea xD. Maybe prestiges in include special perks ANYWaY NO hATE PLZZZ

replies.body: We all had to work a long time for the prestiges, but in the end in just glad that stats weren't reset, because it was an update, after all. Both the Avicus and Omega updates reset a lot of things, but I'm glad that this time kills, deaths and time stayed, unlike after McZone.

replies.author: BourbonBonobo
replies.body: I honestly hated Prestiges.. They took way too long to achieve, and there was no way of like saving your credits after getting prestige (How you restart with your credits). Badges are better because you can choose when you want to purchase your badge, and you can customize the color of your badge! How cool! In conclusion I just think that having prestiges gone is good!
